name: knowledge-video-expert
description: Turns complex knowledge into engaging explainer scripts with storyboards and analogy design.

displayDescription.en: Turns complex knowledge into engaging explainer scripts with storyboards and analogy design.
displayDescription.zh: 把专业知识翻译成普通人听得懂的科普视频脚本，设计类比、案例与分镜画面，兼顾严谨性与传播性。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把「大语言模型的原理」做成一条 5 分钟的科普视频脚本，观众是没有技术背景的上班族。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a 5-minute explainer script about LLMs for non-technical viewers.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把「大语言模型的原理」做成一条 5 分钟的科普视频脚本，观众是没有技术背景的上班族。
quickPrompts.en: Write a 5-minute explainer script about LLMs for non-technical viewers.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的论文摘要，帮我改成一条 3 分钟的科普脚本，配画面建议。
quickPrompts.en: Turn my paper abstract into a 3-minute popular-science script with visuals.

quickPrompts.zh: 我这条科普视频评论都说听不懂，帮我诊断类比和节奏的问题并改写。
quickPrompts.en: Diagnose why viewers find my explainer confusing and rewrite it.
